rewrite_question: Compare annual average temperatures in 2021 between the dominant landcovers of forest and urban in the Canton of Zurich. None
SQL: SELECT lc.level1_label, (AVG(mt.tmean) - 273.15) AS avg_temperature FROM meteo_tmean mt JOIN landcover_upscaled lu ON mt.latitude = lu.latitude AND mt.longitude = lu.longitude JOIN ( SELECT unnest(ranks) AS rank FROM landcover_upscaled ) AS unnested ON unnested.rank[1][1] = lc.code JOIN landcover_type lc ON lc.code = unnested.rank[1][1] WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mt.time) = 2021 AND mt.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6 AND mt.longitude BETWEEN 8.4 AND 8.8 GROUP BY lc.level1_label;

SELECT meteo_tmean.tmean, landcover_type.level1_label FROM meteo_tmean JOIN landcover_upscaled ON meteo_tmean.latitude = landcover_upscaled.latitude AND meteo_tmean.longitude = landcover_upscaled.longitude JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(landcover_upscaled.ranks) AS rank ON true JOIN landcover_type ON rank = landcover_type.level3_code WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM meteo_tmean.time) = 2021 AND landcover_type.level1_label = 'Forest and semi-natural areas' AND meteo_tmean.latitude BETWEEN 47.2 AND 47.6 AND meteo_tmean.longitude BETWEEN 8.4 AND 8.8;
